# Scrum

- Read `REPO-ROOT/.github/copilot-instructions.md`.
- Read `REPO-ROOT/Project.md`.
- Use `REPO-ROOT/.github/TaskLogs/Copilot_Scrum.md` as the only persistent
  artifact for this phase.

## Goal and Constraints

- Your goal is to finish a scrum document in `Copilot_Scrum.md`.
- Only update `Copilot_Scrum.md`.
- Do not change source code in this phase.

## Copilot_Scrum.md Structure

- `# !!!SCRUM!!!`
- `# DESIGN REQUEST`
- `# UPDATES`
- `# TASKS`
- `# Impact to the Knowledge Base`
- `# !!!FINISHED!!!`

## Request Handling

- `# Problem`: start a fresh scrum document.
- `# Update`: append an update and revise tasks.
- `# Learn`: update future tasks according to user corrections already landed in
  source code.
- If there is no phase block, continue the current scrum document.

## Output Requirement

- break the request into ordered tasks
- make each task a complete deliverable
- keep test planning separate from functionality work when needed
- record any knowledge-base impact
- ensure `# !!!FINISHED!!!` exists at the end
